newsletter_text: New origins, limited lots and brew tips. Monthly.
returns_short: Coffee can't be returned once opened. Gear can be returned unused within 14 days. Not happy with a bag? Tell us — we'll make it right.
returns: Unopened coffee and unused brewing gear can be returned within 14 days of delivery. If a coffee isn't to your taste, tell us what you didn't like — we'll suggest a better match and send a replacement bag at half price. Damaged gear on arrival is replaced free; send a photo within 48 hours.

products.name: House Blend
products.short: Our everyday blend. Smooth, sweet, great with or without milk.
desc: A medium roast built for every brewer — espresso, moka pot, pour-over or French press. Balanced and forgiving.
Roasted every Monday. Best between 7 and 30 days after the roast date printed on the bag.

products.name: Midnight Dark Roast
products.short: Bold and heavy-bodied. For kopi lovers and strong lattes.
desc: Roasted dark for a deep, syrupy cup that stands up to condensed milk and lots of ice.

products.name: Highland Single Origin
products.short: A bright, floral single origin. Best as pour-over.
desc: A light roast that keeps the fruit and florals. Brew it as pour-over and let it cool a little — it gets sweeter.

products.name: Crema Espresso Blend
products.short: Built for espresso machines: thick crema, chocolatey shots.
desc: Designed to taste good straight and better with milk.

products.name: Pour-over Starter Kit
products.short: Dripper, glass server, filters and 200 g of Highland. Everything to start.
desc: The easiest way into pour-over. Includes a ceramic dripper, 600 ml glass server, 100 paper filters, a hand grinder and 200 g of Highland Single Origin.
Comes with our printed brew guide.
details: Dripper, server, grinder, filters, 200 g coffee

products.name: Gooseneck Kettle
products.short: A slow, steady pour for even extraction.
desc: A thin spout gives you full control of the pour. 800 ml capacity, works on gas and induction.

products.name: Ceramic Dripper
products.short: A classic cone dripper that holds heat well.
desc: Thick ceramic keeps the temperature stable while you brew. Fits size 02 filters.

products.name: Glass Brewer Set
products.short: A glass brewer and stirrer for clean, bright cups.
desc: Brew for two in one go. Heat-resistant glass, dishwasher safe.

about.title: A small roastery, on purpose
about.lead: Lowlight roasts on one small machine, once a week. That's the whole idea.
paras: Roasting small means every bag leaves within days of roasting, and we can taste every batch before it ships. It also means we sometimes sell out — we think that's a fair trade.
We write tasting notes the way we'd describe a coffee to a friend, not a judge.
values: Every Monday, nothing sits on shelves.
If it's not right, it doesn't ship.
Grind size, brew ratio, which beans — we'll help.

faq: Which coffee should I start with?
House Blend — it works for every brewer and with or without milk. Prefer bold? Midnight. Fruity and bright? Highland.
Whole bean if you have a grinder (freshest). Otherwise choose the grind that matches how you brew: espresso machine, pour-over, or French press.
We roast every Monday and ship within 48 hours. The roast date is printed on every bag.
In the bag, sealed, away from sunlight. Don't refrigerate — it picks up moisture.

Unopened bags within 14 days. If you didn't enjoy a coffee, tell us — we'll help you find a better match.
